items.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023
items.q: I mean he’s my mentor. It’s all — that’s — focused on Harry.

ctx.x: Anything. Yeah. I was, I don’t know, about six or — about seven — and I saw Harry James on television. And I said, “That’s what I want to play, and that’s what I want to do.” So grammar school — you were supposed to be a year older to get a horn but we talked to the teacher and I got a horn from the school, some beat-up old Buescher cornet you know. And I wanted to play. And I started playing and playing in the school band. And then in Oakland, I grew up in Oakland, California, that’s my hometown. And there was a…
Would that include the marching part of it?
